purpose: Experiment E-FND-0139 in the foundations arena: the frozen-gradient localization law: the at-rest species settles at exactly zero displacement with a locked reading at every one of seventeen seed positions (a position-independent exact pin), the previously deep-sinking species shows only shallow drift bounded within two cells everywhere (the deep dive was a configuration transient, caught by the sweep), the massless control never localizes, and with no deep ladder anywhere the last measured candidate for a dynamical mass-hierarchy origin closes, leaving the hierarchy magnitude a free input exactly as the Standard Model holds it, reached by measurement.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
